subject: Insurance
title: Uninsured Motorist Coverage
description: A 60-second lesson on Uninsured Motorist Coverage.

hook.text: About 14% of US drivers have no insurance.

buildup.text: In Mississippi, 29% of drivers are uninsured. In states with high uninsured rates, this coverage is nearly essential.

discovery.text: UM coverage pays for your medical bills, lost wages, and pain and suffering when an at-fault driver has no insurance.

twist.text: Underinsured motorist coverage extends this further.

climax.text: UM coverage is the protection you need because other people don't carry enough.

punchline.text: 14% of drivers uninsured. Your UM coverage pays when their insurance doesn't.

quiz.question: What does uninsured motorist coverage do?
options: Pays for your injuries when an uninsured driver hits you
